notes: This adapter never reruns terminal SV001; it invokes only the existing post-terminal continuation implementation.
HB32 is reference/freshness infrastructure only and grants no execution or transition authority.
The existing resident rendezvous may be used only to read the retained Site custody proof into observed/**; the gateway grants no execution, admission, credential, custody, or SV002 authority.
Any custody state change remains subject to the contemporaneous Interlock/InTr and Master Records authority semantics already required by the canonical handoff.
Task/COSV registration and WorkerCoordinator selection do not authorize custody, SV002 disposition, credentials, or publication.
GitHub tokens, hosted runtime authority, a second heartbeat/oscillator/WorkerCoordinator, and manual human approval are forbidden.
